events: Provider lookup reports NOT_FOUND while the action is pending
Recovery chooses VERIFY_LATER rather than retry
Original remote action commits
Later lookup reports APPLIED
limitation: Evidence uses a deterministic simulated provider, not a real provider.
preconditions: An original irreversible action is accepted remotely
The acknowledgment times out
title: Delayed remote commit after an inconclusive lookup

events: Recovery receives an empty attempt inventory
An inconclusive lookup must not authorize another dispatch
limitation: Unit-level policy evidence; no distributed failure injected.
preconditions: An external outcome has not been independently established
No terminal negative proof is available
title: Empty attempt inventory is not negative proof

events: Commit becomes durable
The connection fails before the caller receives confirmation
Recovery reconciles independently before permitting new effects
limitation: An existing integration test commits through real PostgreSQL and then injects a synthetic ConnectionError after the transaction context exits. A separate database connection confirms the recorded bundle. Additional tests establish UNKNOWN before an in-flight commit and on incomplete or unavailable observations. No real network interruption during COMMIT has been demonstrated. No independent retry-authorization observation has been implemented for this corpus case.
preconditions: An atomic admission transaction is ready to commit
The database can durably commit the full operation bundle
title: Database commit succeeds but acknowledgment is lost

events: Workers concurrently attempt reconciliation
Provider status remains inconclusive
Workers must not issue a duplicate irreversible request
limitation: Policy guard is tested; a true multi-worker race is not established.
preconditions: Two workers target the same operation
A remote action is accepted but remains unresolved
title: Two recovery workers observe one uncertain effect

events: Construct the terminal observation
Validation must reject the unsupported claim
limitation: Existing test expects ValueError; status is an evaluation-level label.
preconditions: An attempt reports PROVEN_NOT_APPLIED
Its required terminal evidence is missing
title: Terminal negative observation without terminal proof

events: Evaluate recovery authorization
Do not authorize another provider dispatch
limitation: This is a unit policy test, not a provider-backed reconciliation.
preconditions: Required terminal negative evidence is present
The remaining retry budget equals zero
title: Negative proof with an exhausted retry budget

events: Replay the exact signed proof
The SQL gate must reject the consumed nonce
Previously committed data must remain unchanged
limitation: Also demonstrated in disposable Docker integration; no corpus runner yet.
preconditions: A valid proof has already committed one operation bundle
Its nonce has been durably consumed
title: Previously consumed signed proof nonce is replayed

events: Inject a database write failure
Abort the admission transaction
Inspect all operation bundle tables after rollback
limitation: Original injected-write test checks three bundle tables; four-table oracle remains to be wired.
preconditions: An operation bundle must commit atomically
The audit or outbox insertion can fail
title: Audit or outbox insertion fails inside admission

events: Change the subject without recomputing the MAC
Submit the modified proof to the SQL gate
Verify that no bundle was admitted
limitation: Tests HMAC integrity, not a compromised signer key.
preconditions: An authenticated signer issues a valid request-bound proof
The SQL gate does not possess a caller-trusted identity assertion
title: Signed subject is changed after proof issuance

events: Issue the proof before the grant is revoked
Commit the grant revocation before the first admission attempt begins
Submit the previously issued proof after revocation commits
Independently verify denial and zero committed bundle rows
limitation: The existing reference test shows that an in-flight admission holds the authorization lock, then commits, after which revocation commits and a newly issued proof is denied. It does not directly test a proof issued before revocation and first submitted after revocation.
preconditions: An authenticated signer issues the proof while the grant is enabled
No admission transaction has started and no operation bundle exists
title: Authorization is revoked after proof issuance
